steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ response screen; the prepared-state contract requires this as the first navigation step.
Enable the RFQ counter-offer behavior required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the setup.
Open the RFQ's evaluation-time editor from the stage Settings menu.
Set the evaluation end to 30 minutes after the current evaluation end and assert that Procol saves the change.
Check that the counter-offer control remains visible after the evaluation-time edit.
Check that Reject Bids remains an enabled RFQ stage action after the edit.
